data.name: Combat Trick / Pinpoint Targeting
data.description: When you use this feat, you can spend stamina points to retain the ability to move. If you spend 2 stamina points, you can take a 5-foot step after you make the attack. If you instead spend 5 stamina points, you can move up to half your speed as a move action.
